name: Imaimai Front Template
headline: Imaimai Front Template - Rapid Web Development
short_description: A modern web application template for Next.js 15 with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. It streamlines front-end development for operations teams, enabling rapid deployment of scalable web interfaces. Integrates with Supabase Auth for secure user management and connects to various tools via its modular architecture.
author: imaimai17468

sections.overview:
imaimai-front-templete is a production-ready web application template combining TanStack Start, TypeScript, and shadcn/ui components. It includes pre-configured Better Auth (Google OAuth), Cloudflare D1 SQLite database with Drizzle ORM, and Cloudflare R2 storage, eliminating boilerplate setup. The template deploys to Cloudflare Workers and runs with full bindings in local development via workerd. Built for AI agents (Claude Code, Cursor) with automated aegis knowledge base generation and agent-aware workflow documentation. Developers get file-based routing, code quality tools (oxlint, oxfmt), testing infrastructure (Vitest), and a modular component architecture out of the box.
Rapidly deploy scalable web interfaces with pre-wired authentication and database
Set up full-stack applications on Cloudflare Workers without infrastructure boilerplate
Develop with AI agents using included agent workflow documentation and aegis integration
Build multi-page applications using TanStack Router with TypeScript type safety
